children: Wireless connectivity provider's Q3 sales rose 9% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 met analyst expectations
Company's gross margin declined due to higher sales of lower-margin enterprise IoT products
Airgain expects Q4 sales between $15.5 mln and $17.5 mln
Company sees Q4 GAAP gross margin between 39.2% and 42.2%
Airgain expects Q4 non-GAAP net income per share of $0.05 at midpoint
ENTERPRISE IOT GROWTH - Higher IoT modem shipments drove a $3.3 mln increase in enterprise sales, offsetting declines in other segments
PRODUCT MIX SHIFT - Gross margin declined due to an unfavorable shift in customer and product mix, with more lower-margin enterprise IoT sales and fewer higher-margin consumer products
SUPPLY CONSTRAINTS - Company said near-term supply constraints continued to affect portions of its business
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the communications & networking peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Airgain Inc is $9.00, about 108.8% above its November 9 closing price of $4.31
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 28 three months ago
